dedupe_keys.name: stations d epurations des hautes pyrenees

description: Stations d’épurations des Hautes-Pyrénées is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Hautes-Pyrénées. Liste des stations d’épuration des Hautes-Pyrénées avec leurs caractéristiques (géo-localisation, capacité, débit nominal, …). Coverage: Département des Hautes-Pyrénées. The publisher named on the listing is Département des Hautes-Pyrénées. Its keywords include epuration, stations, assainissement, territoire. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2020-01-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
